title: COA: 28 of 119 pumps in MMDA stations ‘unserviceable’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Commission on Audit (COA) has found that 28 out of 119 pumps in large pumping stations operated by the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) were “unserviceable,” largely due to “delays in repair and rehabilitation.” “The MMDA, under Republic Act No. 7924, is responsible for managing flood control in Metro Manila,” COA said in its 2025 audit report. “To carry out this mandate, the MMDA operates a network of pumping stations and floodgates.” “Accordingly, pumping stations serve as one of the primary lines of defense against flooding, particularly in low-lying and highly urbanized areas,” the commission added.
